messages:
sara: morning async — onboarding oxford-13b-sq2: merged model config and kicked off a full eval (5k prompts). quick summary and asks below.

anil: thanks — what should we be watching for on regressions?

sara: primary is a ~2.3% drop in helpfulness on the 'billing-invoice' prompt family vs baseline. pattern: hallucinated table rows and currency mismatches. not global but concentrated.

matt: did the quant profile change for this rollout? artifact tag?

sara: yes, switched to `int8-prod-v3`. artifact tag is `oxford-13b-sq2@2026-03-15`. eval id `eval_20260315_37`.

rebecca: infra note — during the run we saw a transient spike on worker-3, restarted the process, looks stable now. logging KV metrics to S3.

dev-bot: deploy completed to staging (oxford-13b-sq2) at 2026-03-15T09:12:05Z :rocket:

jia: I can run a targeted rerun on the failing subset (billing-invoice) and compare int8-prod-v2 vs int8-prod-v3. Want me to include prompt-level diffs?

sara: please do @jia — prompt-level diffs + top 10 counterexamples would be awesome. also tagging @anil for a quick PR review to adjust stop tokens (#PR-4217).

anil: on it, will review today. if it's small I can merge before noon PT.

matt: for local repro, run this snippet: 

```bash
# run single promptset locally against staging
python -m rdinfer.run_eval --model oxford-13b-sq2 --promptset billing-invoice --limit 50 --profile int8-prod-v3
```

matt: FYI the traces show `KVCacheLookup miss rate ~12%` for these prompts — could be prefix normalization or prompt formatting.

rebecca: infra confirms OOM on worker-3 during the heavy tail of the eval, but it was a single container and restart cleared it. I'll follow up with memory profiles.

jia: running the compare now, will post results + a short CSV with per-prompt deltas. ETA ~3h.

sara: blockers: need PR review + infra to validate worker-3 memory profile; everything else on track. today I'll triage the eval diffs and open a bug if the fallback shows regressions.

anil: I'll also add two guardrail edits to the promptset to discourage table augmentation — small changes, low risk.

dev-bot: heads up — nightly eval job at 03:00Z will include oxford-13b-sq2 (so we should have a broader signal tomorrow). :eyes:

sara: thanks all — ping if you hit any late surprises. I'll start a follow-up thread if the compare shows systemic issues.
